question_text: Will Trump end the de minimis exception for all tariffs?
resolution_criteria:
If the de minimis threshold for goods imported to the United States ends (or is reduced to $0) before Jan 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
Reducing it for one or many countries, trade bloc, or sector is not encompassed by the Payout Criterion; it must be for all goods imported to the United States.
